title: EDG Community Update: Week of December 12th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- The new ecosystem project [Console.xyz](https://www.console.xyz/), opened up their [testing phase for the Edgeware community](https://app.console.xyz/c/edgeware).
- Upcoming activities/events: [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament).

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- The [Reddit meme competition](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1603245433530109952) proposed by Gagan is now live for participation.
- Frogman/Rama set up a [brand new portal for Community Calls' recordings](https://recordings.edgeware.cf/0:/).
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-27/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink's oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.

## **Governance**

- Referendum #132: [Subscan's Operational Costs](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/7855-proposal-subscans-operational-costs) {Referendum type: SuperMajority, Democracy Proposal:82, Treasury Proposal ID:113}
- Referendum #133: [SCU Proposal: November 2022](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/8355-scu-proposal-november-2022) {Referendum type: SuperMajority, Democracy Proposal:83, Treasury Proposal ID:114}
